title: How to Start a PJ’s Coffee Franchise: Cost, Investment & Profit Guide 2025 #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - The U.S. coffee industry continues to thrive, fueled by a growing demand for premium beverages and unique café experiences. Among the standout brands leading this movement is PJ’s Coffee of New Orleans, a franchise that blends rich Southern tradition with modern business opportunity.

Founded in 1978 by Phyllis Jordan, PJ’s Coffee is known for its small-batch roasted beans and authentic New Orleans flair. From signature cold-brew coffee to classic beignets, the brand delivers a warm, community centered experience that sets it apart from typical coffee chains. This distinct identity has helped PJ’s grow rapidly across the U.S. and internationally. Not only that, PJ’s Coffee Instagram has grown rapidly and made content based on trends on social media.

PJ’s Coffee is always made from 100% Arabica beans sourced from around the globe, and their signature Original Cold Brew is brewed daily using a cold-drip process that results in a beverage that is about two-thirds less acidic than traditional cold brews.

Entrepreneurs looking for a proven food franchise model can find a strong partner in PJ’s Coffee. The company offers:

  • Established Brand Recognition: Over 45 years of trusted quality and loyal customers.

  • Comprehensive Training & Support: Franchisees receive operational, marketing, and product training to ensure consistency and success.

  • Flexible Footprint Options: From drive-thrus to kiosks and traditional cafés, PJ’s adapts to various market needs.

  • Ongoing Support: Corporate guidance and local marketing initiatives help franchisees thrive in competitive markets.

According to PJ’s official investment disclosures:

  • To qualify as a PJ’s Coffee franchise owner, one must have a minimum of $175,000 in liquid capital and a net worth of at least $500,000. 

  • The initial investment varies depending on the model:

  • Free-standing traditional model (including drive-thru): $915,000 to $1,698,000, with a franchise fee of up to $40,000. 

  • Inline or end-cap traditional model: same franchise fee (up to $40,000), investment in the same ballpark range as free-standing.

  • Non-traditional (small footprint) model (e.g. in airport, university, healthcare facility): $262,500 to $556,000, with a reduced franchise fee (around $30,000).

  • PJ’s also offers multi-unit development option agreements: the first store has the full franchise fee ($40,000), but subsequent units in the agreement pay a reduced fee ($15,000 each).

These financial thresholds and investment ranges reflect the company’s confidence in model scalability and ensure that franchisees are sufficiently capitalized to sustain operations through the start-up phase.

PJ’s Coffee has evolved from a beloved New Orleans neighborhood café into a fast-growing national and international franchise network. As of 2025, PJ’s Coffee operates over 175 locations nationwide, with dozens of new units in development. Over the past decade, the brand has experienced significant expansion across the United States, strategically entering both urban centers and suburban communities where the demand for high-quality coffee experiences is rising.

PJ’s Coffee accelerates growth through flexible store formats, allowing franchisees to open in diverse locations like cafés, drive-thrus, or nontraditional venues. The brand focuses on strategic regional expansion in high-traffic markets, especially across the Southeast, Midwest, and select international regions. Its multi-unit development agreements offer reduced fees for additional stores, encouraging rapid regional growth. Combined with comprehensive franchise support, from real estate and training to marketing and innovation. PJ’s Coffee business provides a strong foundation for scalable success.

Becoming a PJ’s Coffee franchisee means joining a brand with strong financial potential and cultural appeal. With rising demand for quality coffee and café experiences, PJ’s presents an attractive business opportunity for both seasoned entrepreneurs and first-time owners. But success hinges on careful site selection, market planning, and sufficient capital to sustain early operations.

For entrepreneurs seeking to enter the hotel industry, Footprint Floors franchise business is the best choice with the benefits that franchisees would have by joining the franchise. Franchisees can check out the official franchising website for PJ’s Coffee New Orleans. For franchisees who are still looking for an international franchise opportunity or how to get into the Indonesian market, check this out for further information.

title: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen Franchise, The Leading Fried Chicken Franchise in the United States Opening Opportunities Worldwide #StartFranchise
creator: nathanielat.startfriday@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - Fried chicken has always been a popular choice of fast food all around the world, but especially in the United States does fried chicken crown as a popular food choice. One particular franchise has taken the role as one of the leading fried chicken fast food franchises in the United States. Meet Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, an iconic fried chicken spot with bold Louisiana flavors.

Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen itself always makes the list in most iconic fast food fried chicken franchises with its bold flavours and now known with their world-famous chicken sandwich that took the social media in the United States by storm when it was released. Founded in 1972, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen has built a community or a following for their franchise proven by being able to open about 4.000 outlets around the world with over 1.000 being outside of the United States.

Now, through its robust international franchise program, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is offering entrepreneurs worldwide the chance to bring this legendary American fried chicken brand to new territories. Backed by Restaurant Brands International (RBI), the Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise system delivers a scalable business model with strong global demand and full support for multi-unit expansion.

But, what is the opportunity and why does it have to be Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen? 

Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a globally recognized fried chicken franchise that offers a bold, Louisiana-inspired flavor profile. Founded in New Orleans in 1972, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen has grown into one of the top quick-service restaurant (QSR) chains, especially in the chicken category. As part of the RBI family (which also owns Burger King, Tim Hortons, and Firehouse Subs), Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchisee will benefit from strong corporate backing and decades of industry expertise.

With around 4,000 restaurants globally, the Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise continues to attract customers with its unique taste, efficient service model, and authentic Southern heritage. The international franchise strategy focuses on building long-term partnerships with capable operators who are ready to develop multiple restaurants in high-growth markets.

Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise menu is what truly sets it apart. Known for its flavorful fried chicken and spicy seasoning blends, Popeyes delivers a distinctive menu experience that resonates across borders. Not only flavourful fried chicken, they also introduce local Louisiana cuisine into their menu such as Po Boy and Blackened Chicken. But, as an international franchise, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen still introduces a core menu for every franchise internationally to follow within their franchise.

Here are some of the core menu offerings:

  • Spicy and Mild Fried Chicken

  • The Famous Popeyes Chicken Sandwich

  • Chicken Tenders and Nuggets

  • Cajun Fries, Red Beans & Rice, Mashed Potatoes

  • Classic Biscuits and Sweet Treats like Apple Pie

Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise menu can also be tailored to local markets, for example in Indonesia, the fried chicken combo is combined with white rice, core food for Indonesian to eat with chicken, rather than with their cajun fries. While Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise maintains consistency in its core offerings, it allows for regional adaptations to meet cultural and dietary preferences, making it an ideal fit for a diverse range of international franchise markets.

To qualify for the Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen international franchise, investors or future franchisees must meet specific financial and operational criteria. This ensures each franchisee has the capability to grow and sustain a successful multi-unit operation.

Here are the key financial requirements:

  • Minimum Net Worth: USD 1,000,000

  • Liquid Assets: USD 500,000

  • Franchise Fee: From USD 50,000 per restaurant

  • Royalty Fee: Approximately 5% of gross sales

  • Marketing Fund Contribution: Around 4% of gross sales

  • Development Commitment: Typically 5 or more restaurants per agreement

Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise opportunity is geared more toward experienced foodservice operators or investor groups who have the financial resources and business acumen to scale the brand in new international territories.

1. Strong Global Brand
Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen brings decades of heritage, a loyal fan base, and a globally recognized brand identity that opens doors in competitive foodservice markets.

2. Scalable Multi-Unit Model
Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise focuses on growth through multi-unit development, making it ideal for partners who want to scale rapidly and dominate in key cities or regions.

3. Backed by Restaurant Brands International
As part of RBI, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchise benefits from access to a vast network of operational support, supply chain systems, and franchise development expertise.

4. Focus on Local Expertise
Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen seeks franchise partners with strong knowledge of their local market, enabling more precise site selection, marketing, and customer engagement strategies.

5. Proven International Potential
With successful launches in countries across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen international franchise model has already proven it can work across a wide range of cultures and consumer preferences.

Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen has proven its worth inside of their own hometown and also in multiple places internationally, showing that it is a great franchise and a safe spot for future franchisees who want to get into the international F&B business. Interested in opening your own Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen in your country? Check out Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen official franchising website to see the opportunities lie in front of you in joining this fried chicken train.

StartFranchise.id - Inovasi selalu terjadi dimanapun, baik di dunia teknologi, pekerjaan hingga di kuliner. Sektor kuliner selalu berinovasi untuk menghadirkan rasa baru ataupun  cara baru untuk menikmati rasa yang sudah ada secara praktis. Inovasi ini yang berhasil dilakukan oleh Aladdin Kebab. Brand ini berhasil membuat inovasi dalam membuat kebab mereka bisa dijangkau secara praktis dan dinikmati kapanpun oleh para konsumen dengan produk terbaru Aladdin Kebab, D’Froz. 

D’Froz adalah kebab frozen yang dihasilkan oleh Aladdin Kebab untuk membantu para konsumen yang rindu untuk konsumsi kebab secara praktis dan bisa kapanpun tanpa perlu menunggu outlet Aladdin Kebab di area mereka untuk buka terlebih dahulu. D’Froz juga menghadirkan rasa baru yang tidak ada di Aladdin Kebab, sehingga menjadi sebuah ketertarikan juga dari konsumen setia Aladdin Kebab untuk mencoba D’Froz.

Kebab frozen yang tersedia di D’Froz by Aladdin Kebab tidak hanya terfokus pada kebab asin yang tersebar banyak di seluruh Indonesia, D’Froz by Aladdin Kebab juga menghadirkan varian kebab manis yang memanjakan lidah dan menjadi opsi pilihan apabila konsumen sudah mulai bosan dengan cemilan asin.

Banana Choco Cheese : Kebab frozen dengan varian Banana Choco Cheese hadir menjadi opsi cemilan manis dengan varian baru tetapi rasa yang familiar dengan lidah-lidah orang Indonesia. Varian ini mungkin bisa mengingatkan para konsumen dengan rasa dari gorengan Piscok tetapi versi lebih mengenyangkan

Banana Berries : Varian Banana Berries cocok untuk para konsumen yang ingin manis-manis buah dengan sedikit asin dari keju dan juga creamy dari es krim dibalut dalam kulit tortilla yang siap dihangatkan oleh konsumen.

Mozarella Cheese : Varian Mozarella Cheese membawa kembali kebab varian asin dengan keju mozarella yang molor. Cocok untuk para konsumen yang suka cemilan mozarella kekinian tetapi ingin kenyang dalam makan cemilannya

Original Mayo : Varian Original Mayo menjadi jawaban untuk para konsumen yang mencari alternatif kebab yang biasanya dijual sebagai stok cemilan di rumah.

Menu yang variatif serta cara penyajian yang praktis membuat produk terbaru dari Aladdin Kebab, D’Froz menjadi sebuah produk yang cocok untuk stok camilan darurat di rumah oleh konsumen setia Aladdin Kebab. D’Froz juga bisa menjadi alternatif ataupun tambahan dari para mitra ataupun calon mitra yang tertarik dengan kemitraan Aladdin Kebab karena D’Froz juga membuka kesempatan untuk para pelaku usaha menjadi reseller resmi dari D’Froz sendiri.

title: Proposal Franchise, Impresi Pertama Franchisor Sebelum Dealing Franchise #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - Kata-kata “Don’t Judge a Book By Its Cover” sebetulnya tidak terlalu benar karena orang selalu melihat terlebih dahulu apa yang ada di depan mereka lalu sudah membuat konklusi bagaimana sesuatu tersebut. Sama halnya dengan wawancara pekerjaan, beberapa riset mengatakan bahwa seseorang hanya memiliki 30 detik untuk dapat dipilih diterima atau tidak dalam pekerjaan tersebut.

Ini sama halnya dengan proposal franchise. Setiap franchisee akan melihat proposal saat awal-awal para franchisor akan melakukan dealing secara virtual dan itu akan menjadi make or break dari deal franchise tersebut. Proposal franchise yang tidak lengkap maupun yang tidak memberikan informasi yang jelas akan membuat para franchisee langsung mengabaikan dan tidak ingin bekerja sama karena akan terkesan “tidak profesional.” Agar para franchisor tidak mengalami hal tersebut, berikut ada beberapa hal yang perlu dimasukkan di proposal franchise para franchisor agar bisa memberikan impresi pertama yang menuju dealing!

Sebagai pembuka, para franchisor bisa mencantumkan apa itu bisnis mereka. Apa itu bisnis mereka bisa mencakup nama dari brand franchise itu sendiri, apa yang ditawarkan oleh brand dari franchise sebagai contoh apabila bergerak di bidang F&B, maka bisa disebutkan makanan atau minuman apa yang dijual. Franchisor juga bisa menambahkan background story dari perusahaannya yang dapat “menjual” franchise tersebut.

Selain pertanyaan apa, franchisor juga bisa menjawab pertanyaan “siapa” dalam siapa yang menjadi target pasar dari usaha franchise tersebut untuk membantu franchisee dalam siapa saja yang menjadi target pasarnya. Hal ini tentunya akan membantu dalam proses dealing agar memastikan bahwa usaha dari para franchisor bisa sejajar dengan visi dari franchisee yang ingin berjualan ke target market tertentu.

Hal berikutnya yang sangat perlu dicantumkan di dalam proposal franchise yang dapat membantu proses dealing adalah keunikan franchise tersebut yang membuat franchise tersebut stand out dari yang lain. Dengan peluang bisnis yang semakin banyak, maka keunikan akan sangat berperan penting dalam memenangkan hati para franchisee.

Keunikan tersebut akan membantu dalam alasan mengapa harus bergabung kepada franchise tersebut. Keunikan juga bisa dibantu dengan keunggulan yang membuat franchisee semakin yakin dengan franchise para franchisor.

Bagian ini akan menjadi bagian yang paling penting bagi para franchisor, jadi perlu diperhatikan poin-poin penting yang akan dimasukkan sebagai penarik para franchisee. Hal ini sudah dibuktikan dengan franchise Rotinya Rakyat dimana unique selling point (USP) mereka berada di modal yang rendah sehingga menimbulkan banyaknya leads yang diterima oleh mereka dengan munculnya juga para franchisee baru dari Rotinya Rakyat.

Franchisor juga bisa menambahkan simulasi omset dari penjualan produk franchise dan juga periode BEP yang masuk akal dan realistis, bukan yang menipu. BEP cepat memang menjadi salah satu alasan mengapa seorang franchisee bergabung dengan sebuah franchise tertentu, tetapi pihak franchisor tetap harus bertanggung jawab dengan periode yang diberikan dan bukan hanya asal menaruh periode yang menggiurkan.

Biasanya, simulasi omset dan BEP akan terbagi menjadi 3 segmen yang bisa memberikan gambaran untuk para franchisee, mulai dari optimis, normal dan realistis atau mungkin dikemasnya dalam bentuk rame, normal, dan sepi. Hal ini bisa menjadi pedoman untuk para franchisor yang sedang membuat proposal franchise agar bisa menjanjikan periode BEP yang singkat dengan hitungan yang bisa dilihat.

Franchisor bisa menambahkan paket-paket kemitraan atau franchise untuk menjadi selling point kedua dari proposal franchise para franchisor. Bagian paket franchise atau kemitraan juga dapat menjadi tempat para franchisor memberikan keunggulan dari franchise mereka. Contohnya seperti apabila join franchise A dengan paket Z, maka franchisee akan mendapatkan pelatihan dan marketing secara lengkap.

Harga yang mendetail serta keunggulan atau keuntungan dari bergabung bersama franchise akan sangat membantu proses dealing karena para franchisee sudah tau ekspektasi apa yang akan mereka terima pada saat bergabung dengan franchise tersebut.

Terakhir, para franchisor dapat memberikan kontak aktif agar para franchisee dapat dengan mudah menghubungi apabila tertarik dengan tawaran dari proposal franchise tersebut. Kontak yang diberikan dapat berupa nomor Whatsapp, Instagram resmi atau mungkin email resmi perusahaan.

title: Starbucks Licensing Opportunity, International Coffee Shop with Profit for Partners #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - Coffee has become a staple in today’s society. From every person, whether from every age, gender or occupation, everyone seems to rely on caffeine produced by coffee to get on with their day. This might be one of the reasons why in some countries there are new upcoming coffee shops opening every day. Despite new coffee shops opening, there is one brand who is always trusted for a lot of people’s coffee fix.

Starbucks has been the international coffee shop who is trusted all around the world and has become the most iconic coffee shop either for their coffee or their other treats. Founded in 1971 in Seattle, Starbucks has achieved global status not only from their coffee, but also how they have branded themselves which results in people knowing Starbucks in an instance.

Unlike many fast food franchise industries, Starbucks has a different business model of a franchise that helps them in maintaining their quality internationally which results in customers being more satisfied all across the world as they would get the same taste from their local Starbucks when they are on a holiday or working abroad. This also helps future franchisees who have been in the coffee industry to elevate their business in joining Starbucks.

Starbucks is an international coffee shop offering a wide range of beverages and food items, from handcrafted espresso drinks and Frappuccinos to teas, juices, pastries, and sandwiches. Starbucks also features Starbucks Reserve locations, which highlight rare, single-origin coffees in a premium setting.

With over 38,000 stores globally, Starbucks has built a strong reputation for being more than just a coffee shop. Starbucks is also a “third place” between home and work where customers can relax, work, or socialize.

Starbucks offers a diverse menu catering to various tastes. Starbucks also kept some core items to ensure the quality of the coffee 

  • Hot & Iced Coffee Beverages: Lattes, cappuccinos, americanos, and cold brew.

  • Frappuccino® Blended Beverages: Signature ice-blended drinks with flavors like caramel, mocha, and matcha.

  • Tea & Refreshers: Teavana® teas, iced teas, and fruit-based refreshers.

  • Food Items: Fresh pastries, sandwiches, wraps, and salads.

Not only food and beverages, Starbucks also introduces tumblers and mugs specially made by Starbucks for the loyal customers to collect as the tumblers can also be used to get a discount when buying a Starbucks beverage.

The brand regularly introduces seasonal and limited-edition products whether in their beverage or tumblers to keep the menu exciting for customers also a time for customers to explore the menu offered by Starbucks

Unlike many well-known F&B franchises, Starbucks does not offer traditional franchise agreements. The majority of its outlets are either company-operated or licensed with licensing being more common in specific international markets or unique locations like airports, universities, and retail chains.

Through this model, Starbucks maintains full control over store design, product quality, and overall customer experience, ensuring consistency across all locations internationally.

While Starbucks does not have a standard franchise fee, it charges a licensing fee for approved partners. According to Wolf of Franchise and Profitable Venture, these are the fees in opening a licensed Starbucks shop : 

  • Average Licensing Fee: Around USD 315,000

  • Total Estimated Investment: From USD 228,620 up to approximately USD 2.9 million (including store build-out, equipment, initial inventory, and training)

  • Net Worth Requirement: Minimum USD 700,000

This investment range reflects Starbucks’ high brand value and the premium locations where its outlets are typically placed.

With Starbucks being a licensed shop business model and not a global franchise model, it comes with advantages for both Starbucks and the people who got the license to operate a Starbucks outlet, which are : 

Brand Power & Global Recognition – Starbucks is one of the most recognized coffee brands in the world, instantly attracting loyal customers wherever they are from. Giving trust even though they never went to the new Starbucks.

Strict Quality & Consistency – Starbucks’ centralized control ensures uniform standards across all outlets, maintaining product taste and customer experience, ensuring every part of the world will always fulfill the expectation of a loyal customer when they go to a new Starbucks outlet.

Premium Customer Experience – Starbucks focuses on creating a welcoming “third place” atmosphere, increasing repeat visits and customer loyalty.

Selective Partnerships – By limiting licensing to highly qualified partners, Starbucks protects its brand and ensures each location is run to the highest standard.


Starbucks’ global reputation and its consistency as a licensed shop and not a franchise makes Starbucks a perfect spot for entrepreneurs who want to get into the coffee shop business and want a safe place to do so. Although a traditional franchise is not available for Starbucks, you can join the licensing program to become a partner in the world’s renowned coffee shop.

title: Startup vs Franchise Mana yang Lebih Cocok untuk Memulai Bisnis #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - Perjalanan awal dalam membuat bisnis adalah dengan menanyakan sebuah pertanyaan yang sering dipikirkan oleh para entrepreneur: apakah lebih baik menciptakan sesuatu dari nol atau ikut jalur yang sudah terbukti? Hal ini menjadi dasar dilema dari para entrepreneur dalam mengambil sistem antara startup vs franchise. Keduanya punya peluang besar, tapi juga memiliki cara kerja, risiko, dan tingkat kebebasannya yang berbeda. Startup itu ibaratnya seperti membangun rumah sendiri dari awal, sementara franchise ibarat membeli rumah siap huni lengkap dengan sistem dan aturan yang jelas.

Untuk para calon entrepreneur agar tidak bingung dalam memilih mana yang menjadi pilihan terbaik bagi mereka yang sesuai dengan motivasi atau tujuan berbisnis, artikel ini akan membahas seluruh pengertian, perbedaan dan juga keuntungan dari startup dan franchise.

Startup adalah perusahaan rintisan yang biasanya fokus pada inovasi dan solusi baru di pasar. Startup memberi kebebasan kepada para entrepreneur untuk berkreasi, menentukan strategi sendiri, dan mencoba ide-ide unik sesuka mereka ataupun sekreatif mereka melalui ide yang langsung muncul.

Namun, startup juga berisiko tinggi karena bisnisnya masih mencari bentuk dan brand belum dikenal luas. Modal awal bisa bervariasi, tergantung skala ide yang dijalankan. Selain itu, startup memiliki kesempatan gagal yang lebih tinggi daripada franchise. Menurut Investopedia, hampir 50% startup gagal dalam lima tahun pertama karena kurangnya perencanaan dan pengalaman pendiri

Berbeda dengan startup, franchise adalah model bisnis dimana para entrepreneur bisa langsung menjalankan usaha dengan brand, sistem, dan dukungan dari perusahaan yang sudah mapan. Franchisee mengikuti standar operasional dan strategi pemasaran yang sudah terbukti, sehingga risiko kegagalan relatif lebih rendah, hanya sekitar 4% dalam lima tahun pertama sebuah franchise bisa gagal menurut Investopedia, sangat berbanding terbalik dengan startup

Startup atau yang sekarang lagi trending disebut pelaksana startup ini sebagai perintis tentunya akan membawa sebuah keuntungan dalam membuatnya, tetapi tentunya akan membawa kerugian atau halangan juga yang cukup signifikan, seperti harus mengeluarkan tenaga yang lebih untuk memastikan bisnisnya berjalan menurut Forbes. Selain itu, masih banyak keuntungan dan juga kerugian yang bisa menjadi bahan pertimbangan para calon entrepreneur, diantaranya: 

  • Kreativitas Tanpa Batas : Para entrepreneur bisa langsung menentukan strategi, inovasi produk, dan branding sesuai visi sendiri sesuai dengan bagaimana penggambaran mereka ketika mencetuskan brand mereka.

  • Potensi Keuntungan Besar : Jika diterima pasar, pertumbuhan akan secara cepat yang bisa membuat startup ini sendiri langsung bersaing dengan franchise dan mendapatkan profit yang tinggi.

  • Fleksibilitas Operasional : Para pelaku bisnis bisa langsung menyesuaikan atau mengeluarkan produk atau layanan sesuai tren terbaru tanpa perlu menunggu izin dari orang lain.

  • Kontrol Penuh : Para entrepreneur akan memiliki kendali penuh dalam operasional dan proyeksi bisnisnya. Semua keputusan ada di tangan pendiri, termasuk strategi promosi dan ekspansi.

  • Pengalaman Bisnis Mendalam : Startup cocok untuk para entrepreneur yang ingin memiliki pengalaman bisnis yang lebih daripada franchise. Startup akan mengasah kemampuan para entrepreneur di berbagai aspek bisnis, mulai dari marketing, keuangan, HR, dan inovasi produk.

  • Risiko Tinggi : Banyak startup yang gagal karena pasar belum menerima produk atau strategi tidak efektif.

  • Modal dan Waktu Besar : Membangun brand dan sistem dari nol membutuhkan investasi besar dan waktu lama dibandingkan dengan franchise yang sudah memiliki keduanya.

  • Persaingan Ketat : Para entrepreneur harus bersaing dengan startup lain maupun bisnis atau franchise yang sudah memiliki nama yang besar.

  • Tekanan Tinggi :  Semua tanggung jawab, baik operasional maupun pengembangan bisnis ada di tangan pendiri, sehingga akan memberikan tekanan yang sangat besar dalam menjamin kesuksesan bisnisnya.

  • Adaptasi Cepat : Para entrepreneur harus cepat menyesuaikan diri dengan perubahan tren pasar agar bisnis tetap relevan untuk bersaing dengan bisnis yang memiliki reputasi.

Franchise memberikan keuntungan kepada para entrepreneur untuk bisa segera memulai bisnisnya dengan sistem yang bisa langsung jalan dalam waktu yang singkat. Tetapi, franchise sendiri akan membawa efek negatif, terutama dalam membatasi pergerakan para pelaku bisnis ini. Berikut keuntungan dan kerugian dari franchise yang bisa menjadi pertimbangan para pelaku usaha dalam memulai bisnisnya.

  • Sistem Teruji : SOP yang jelas membuat bisnis mudah dijalankan bahkan oleh semua orang, baik pemula maupun yang sudah pernah bermain di dunia bisnis.

  • Dukungan Lengkap : Franchisor akan menyediakan pelatihan, marketing, hingga bantuan operasional kepada para entrepreneur yang bergabung bersama.

  • Brand Recognition : Nama besar dari franchisor akan mempermudah promosi dan menarik pelanggan lebih cepat kepada bisnis para franchisee.

  • Lebih Aman : Risiko kegagalan dari franchise relatif rendah dibanding startup.

  • Balik Modal Lebih Cepat : Karena sistem berjalan dan brand dikenal, potensi profit terjamin lebih cepat dari startup yang belum tentu bisa sukses semalam.

  • Fokus Operasional dan Pengembangan : Para entrepreneur bisa fokus menjalankan bisnis baik dari operasional dan juga pengembangan bisnis tanpa harus memikirkan inovasi besar atau branding dari awal.

  • Biaya Awal Lebih Tinggi : Investasi awal bisa sangat besar tergantung paket dan brand franchise. Semakin besar nama brand akan membuat biaya awal lebih tinggi dalam franchisenya.

  • Keterbatasan Kreativitas : Para entrepreneur harus mengikuti aturan franchisor yang membuat sulit dalam berinovasi bebas.

  • Royalti dan Biaya Tambahan : Para entrepreneur wajib membayar royalti atau biaya operasional tambahan kepada para franchisor yang berdampak pada omset yang didapatkan.

  • Ketergantungan Sistem : Keberhasilan dari bisnis yang dimiliki bergantung pada dukungan dan reputasi franchisor.

  • Kurang Fleksibel : Para entrepreneur akan kesulitan melakukan penyesuaian lokal karena harus mengikuti sistem franchisor.

Startup akan menjadi model bisnis yang cocok untuk para calon pelaku usaha atau entrepreneur yang benar-benar ingin menjadi “100% entrepreneur” yang memiliki lebih banyak tantangan tetapi bisa mengendalikan secara penuh operasional dan proyeksi ekspansi bisnis yang dimiliki. Franchise menjadi model bisnis bagi para entrepreneur yang ingin berbisnis lebih aman dengan sudah adanya nama brand dan juga SOP yang jelas.

Mau startup atau franchise, sistem bisnis yang terbaik bagi para entrepreneur adalah yang sesuai dengan tujuan, kemampuan dan juga gaya bisnis dari para entrepreneur masing-masing. Untuk para entrepreneur yang sudah tertarik dengan franchise, bisa langsung cek peluang-peluang yang tersedia melalui artikel di Start Franchise, atau langsung cek di Instagram atau TiktokStart Franchise atau bisa langsung ke Whatsapp resmi Start Franchise untuk tanya-tanya dengan tim Start Franchise!

title: Startup vs Franchise, The Best Business Model for Entrepreneurs to Dive Into #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id – At the beginning of every business journey, entrepreneurs often face the same fundamental question: is it better to build something from scratch or follow a proven path? This is the dilemma when comparing franchise vs startup. Both models hold massive potential, but they operate differently, carry distinct risks, and offer varying levels of freedom. If a startup is like building your own house brick by brick, then a franchise is like moving into a fully furnished home complete with clear rules of the house complex and systems inside the house.

For aspiring entrepreneurs, choosing between a startup vs franchise can be confusing. To make the decision easier, let’s explore what each business model means, their advantages, disadvantages, and which might be the right fit depending on your goals.

A startup is a new business venture typically focused on innovation and bringing fresh solutions to the market. It gives entrepreneurs full freedom to create strategies, develop unique ideas, and build their brand exactly how they imagine it without any restriction but their idea block. However, startups come with high risks since the brand has not made an impact to society with no recognition at all and the business model is still finding its shape.

According to Investopedia, nearly 50% of startups fail within the first five years, often due to lack of planning or limited experience of the founders. Startups also require significant time and capital, depending on the scale of the idea.

Unlike a startup, a franchise allows entrepreneurs to run a business under an established brand with proven systems and full support from the franchisor. Franchisees follow clear operational standards and marketing strategies that already work. This greatly reduces the risk of failure. In fact, Investopedia notes that only about 4% of franchises fail within the first five years, a massive contrast to startups.

Startups as the free will of business has its advantage, but also it has its disadvantages, including with it being too risky.

  • Unlimited Creativity : Entrepreneurs have full control over product innovation, branding, and strategy.

  • High Profit Potential : If successful, a startup can grow rapidly and compete with big names.

  • Operational Flexibility : Founders can adapt to market trends instantly without approvals.

  • Full Control : Every decision lies in the hands of the entrepreneur, from expansion to marketing.

  • Deep Business Experience : Running a startup provides entrepreneurs with hands-on learning across all aspects of business.

  • High Risk : Many startups fail because the market isn’t ready or strategies don’t work.

  • Time and Capital Intensive : Building everything from scratch requires more investment compared to a franchise.

  • Tough Competition : Startups compete with both established brands and fellow new ventures.

  • High Pressure : The responsibility of growth and survival lies entirely on the founder and does not have a safety net.

  • Constant Adaptation : Founders must keep up with shifting market trends to stay relevant.

Advantages and Disadvantages of Franchises

Franchise as the safer option for beginner has a lot of advantages to help the business start, but it also comes with disadvantages in developing the business.

  • Proven Systems : Clear SOPs make it easy even for beginners to run a business.

  • Strong Support : Franchisors provide training, marketing, and operational assistance.

  • Brand Recognition : Well-known names attract customers faster.

  • Lower Risk : Failure rates are significantly lower than startups.

  • Faster ROI : Profits can come quicker due to established demand.

  • Focus on Growth : Franchisees can focus on operations without worrying about building a brand from scratch.

  • Higher Initial Cost : Big-name franchises often require a large investment.

  • Limited Creativity : Innovation is restricted by franchisor rules.

  • Royalty Fees : Ongoing payments can cut into profit margins.

  • System Dependency : Success relies heavily on the franchisor’s reputation and support.

  • Less Flexibility : Local customization may be limited by strict guidelines.

Choosing between startup vs franchise depends entirely on your entrepreneurial goals. A startup is ideal for those who want to be “a true entrepreneur”, fully in control and ready to take on higher risks for potentially bigger rewards, just like hitting a jackpot. A franchise, on the other hand, is better suited for those seeking safer opportunities with proven systems, strong branding, and lower failure rates.

At the end of the day, the best business model is the one that fits the vision, resources, and entrepreneurial style of each entrepreneur. Whether you lean towards a startup or franchise, the important thing is to take the leap and start your journey. For those already considering franchise opportunities, explore the latest options on StartFranchise.id!

title: Steps on How to Register a Local Business in Jakarta for Future Business Person #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - Starting a business in Indonesia can be a land of profit waiting, but the business person still needs to find the perfect land to do so. One place where it could all happen is in Jakarta. Jakarta is a land of promising opportunity as it is still the capital of Indonesia and a major economic hub where all the economics of Indonesia happens. Jakarta offers a vast market for both local and foreign entrepreneurs. However, before officially running your business, it is crucial to understand the process of how to register a local business in Jakarta properly.

Following the right steps will not only give the business a strong legal foundation to avoid all those legal problems that could bite you on the way,  but also build trust with customers and partners. Here are the step-by-step guidelines every future business person who wants to take the opportunity in Jakarta needs to know.

The first step in how to register a local business in Jakarta is to choose the right legal entity for your company. In Indonesia, common options include:

  • PT (Limited Liability Company): Suitable for medium to large-scale businesses.

  • CV (Limited Partnership): Often chosen for small to medium businesses.

  • Firma (Partnership): Typically for businesses run by multiple individuals with full responsibility.

  • Sole Proprietorship (UD): A simpler structure for individual businesses.

Choosing the right structure will affect taxation, ownership, and legal requirements. All business people must choose the correct one as picking a legal entity that is below your scale could get your business in legal trouble such as tax evasion and many more.

Once the future investor in Jakarta has decided on the legal entity, the next step is to reserve a business name. The name must be unique and not already registered by another company. One tip to choose your name is to avoid superlatives like “best”  and keep it under three Bahasa words for faster approval.  For PT, this process is done through the AHU Online system under the Ministry of Law and Human Rights.

The reservation usually takes a few days for approval. Make sure the name follows the rules and does not infringe on any existing trademark.

For entities such as PT or CV, the Deed of Establishment must be drafted and legalized by a notary. This document includes basic company details such as name, office address, ownership structure, and capital investment.

Once signed, the notary will register the deed with the Ministry of Law and Human Rights for official approval. So, for foreign investors, it is recommended to find a local notary first that can help your legal process faster and safer.

Every company in Jakarta is required to have a Tax Identification Number (NPWP). This can be registered at the local tax office or online. NPWP is essential for corporate tax reporting and financial administration so the business opened will be confirmed legally and there won’t be any problem.

In order to get the NPWP, the business person need to provide these documents so the NPWP can be processed : 

  • Copy of the Deed of Establishment and Ministry approval

  • Business Domicile Letter (Surat Keterangan Domisili Usaha)

  • Business Identification Number (NIB) if already available

  • Director’s Identification Card (KTP) or passport for foreigners

Future investors or business people need to apply for a Business Identification Number (NIB) via the Online Single Submission (OSS) system. The NIB serves as the official company ID, and also functions as:

  • Company Registration Certificate (TDP)

  • Importer Identification Number (API)

  • Access to sector-specific licenses

Some industries require extra licenses. Every business person needs to make sure the business they are going to open already fulfills the permits needed for their business sector. Some sectors that need permits are : 

  • Food & Beverage businesses may need distribution permits.

  • Construction companies may need permits from professional associations.

Always double check industry-specific requirements to avoid compliance issues from the government and ensure the business stays on track and safe.

A registered office address is mandatory to show that the business is legit. If you use a virtual office, make sure that it is officially licensed. In many cases, a Domicile Letter will also be required for the registration process to make sure that the foreign investor actually is in Indonesia and is able to run the business.

Once the business person has completed all steps above, in getting the Deed of Establishment, NPWP, NIB, and any sector-specific permits, then the company has officially registered in the Indonesian system. They can now:

  • Open a corporate bank account

  • Apply for business loans

  • Build partnerships with stronger credibility

Knowing how to register a local business in Jakarta is key to building a strong and legitimate business in Indonesia’s best land of opportunity. While the process may involve several steps, each is designed to give the company a legal recognition and credibility so the government won’t shut the business down.

For future business persons, completing this process not only ensures compliance but also lays the groundwork for long-term success in Jakarta’s competitive market. If you are interested in knowing more about the business opportunity in Indonesia or how to be a part of it in Indonesia, you can check here for more information.

content:
StartFranchise.id - Strategi bisnis Ayam Keprabon berawal dengan konsep sederhana yaitu menghadirkan ayam geprek dengan cita rasa autentik dan porsi melimpah. Berawal dari Surakarta, Ayam Keprabon ini kini telah menjadi salah satu pemain besar di industri kuliner cepat saji Indonesia, dikenal dengan menu Ayam Geprek Sambal Korek dan Ayam Geprek Keju Mozarella yang menggoda selera. Melihat di Instagram Ayam Keprabon yang selalu menunjukan menu mozarella membuat audiens tergiur melihatnya.

  1. Segmenting

    Strategi bisnis Ayam Keprabon dengan melakukan segmentasi pasar dengan memahami siapa pelanggan yang paling mungkin tertarik dengan produknya. Mulai dari pelajar, mahasiswa, hingga karyawan muda yang cenderung sering makan di luar. Strategi bisnis Ayam Keprabon menarik dan menargetkan konsumen yang menyukai makanan pedas, porsi besar, dan cita rasa khas Indonesia yang otentik. Kelompok ini juga biasanya aktif di media sosial, gemar mencoba makanan baru, serta peka terhadap tren kuliner yang sedang viral.

  2. Targeting

    Strategi bisnis Ayam Keprabon adalah dengan menerapkan mass targeting, yaitu menargetkan pasar yang luas namun tetap relevan. Ayam Keprabon tidak menjangkau berbagai kalangan masyarakat menengah, baik mahasiswa, pekerja kantoran, hingga keluarga muda. Mereka semua memiliki kesamaan kebutuhan yaitu ingin menikmati makanan yang lezat, cepat disajikan, dan ramah di kantong. Untuk menjangkau target ini, Ayam Keprabon memilih lokasi outlet di area strategis seperti dekat kampus, pusat kuliner, dan kawasan bisnis yang memiliki arus pengunjung tinggi. Strategi pemasarannya juga menyesuaikan dengan perilaku target pasar, dengan memanfaatkan media sosial seperti Instagram dan TikTok untuk membangun awareness. 

  3. Positioning

    Rasa premium dengan harga yang terjangkau bisa menggambarkan strategi bisnis Ayam Keprabon. Positioning ini kuat karena menyentuh dua sisi penting bagi konsumen Indonesia yaitu, kelezatan rasa rumahan yang familiar, dan sentuhan modern yang membuatnya tetap menarik. Strategi bisnis Ayam Keprabon berhasil membangun identitas sebagai brand lokal yang autentik, terjangkau, tapi tetap berkualitas tinggi.

  • Konsistensi Kualitas dan Cita Rasa: Setiap outlet memastikan standar rasa dan penyajian tetap sama.

  • Harga Terjangkau, Porsi Melimpah: Menyasar segmen middle market yang mencari value for money.

  • Ekspansi Agresif di Kota-Kota Besar: Brand ini memanfaatkan momentum tren makanan pedas dan kuliner lokal.

  • Kehadiran Digital Marketing yang Aktif: Ayam Keprabon aktif di media sosial, membangun engagement dengan konten relatable dan promosi kreatif.

Jika dilihat dari rekam jejak, strategi branding, dan loyalitas pelanggan, strategi bisnis Ayam Keprabon masih menjadi salah satu franchise kuliner yang menjanjikan di 2025. Ayam Keprabon membuktikan bahwa bisnis kuliner lokal bisa bersaing lewat rasa, konsistensi, dan inovasi. Di tengah tren kuliner yang terus berubah, brand ini tetap relevan dan dicintai pelanggan. Namun, pada saat ini Ayam Keprabon sedang tidak membuka franchise atau kemitraan.

title: Taco Bell Franchise Business,The Leading Mexican Inspired Cuisine Franchise #StartFranchise

content:
StartFranchise.id -  “Live Más” is more than just a tagline, it is also the bold lifestyle statement carried by the Taco Bell franchise, a global fast food brand specializing in Mexican-inspired cuisine. Founded in 1962 in California, Taco Bell has grown into one of the strongest international brands under Yum! Brands, alongside KFC and Pizza Hut. Even though Taco Bell is not the authentic Mexican cuisine, it still brings the popular Mexican cuisine to the mass public.

With more than 8,000 restaurants in over 30 countries, Taco Bell franchise has built a reputation for profitability, innovation, and global appeal revolving around Mexican cuisine. From tacos and burritos to nachos and quesadillas, Taco Bell continues to lead the fast food market with bold and spicy flavors along with their creative marketing strategies. Not only that, Taco Bell franchise business offers a lot to future franchisees that want to join the Live Más way of living.

The Taco Bell franchise is a world-class fast food business specializing in Mexican-inspired cuisine. Operating under Yum! Brands Inc., one of the largest restaurant companies worldwide, Taco Bell is known for its bold menu, creative product launches, and ability to adapt to local markets while keeping its international identity. Taco Bell has also known to be a collaborative brand as they have done so with other Mexican-inspired brands like Doritos in creating the Doritos Locos Tacos

Franchisees can choose from flexible restaurant models, such as freestanding outlets, in-line stores, drive-thru units, or express formats for high-traffic areas like airports and universities. With brand strength, operational systems, and global support, the Taco Bell franchise business offers new and upcoming entrepreneurs or even those who have dived in the fast food business a proven path to success which has been proven to be successful in multiple countries from all regions, giving a sign that it is not specific to one place only and able to be accepted anywhere.

Taco Bell's menu is designed to be bold and innovative just like their slogan “Live Más”. They offer a wide selection of Mexican-inspired fast food that has become the fan favorite. As an international franchise, Taco Bell offers core items which include:

  • Tacos: Crunchy Taco and Soft Taco with its filling

  • Burritos: Bean Burrito, Beef Burrito, and customizable options.

  • Quesadillas: Cheese Quesadilla, Chicken Quesadilla.

  • Nachos: Loaded Nachos, Nachos Bell Grande.

  • Signature Creations: Crunchwrap Supreme, Chalupas, Mexican Pizza.

  • Sides & Desserts: Cinnamon Twists, Chips with Salsa, Fries (in select regions).

  • Beverages: Baja Blast as the signature drink and soft drinks.

These core menus are served everywhere in Taco Bell to ensure the same quality as an international franchise alongside with limited-time specials and regional menu adaptations. With this approach, Taco Bell franchise business ensures constant excitement for loyal customers and customer engagement for new customers in every market, despite the region having not tried any Mexican-inspired food.

Starting a Taco Bell franchise needs a huge investment as it has become a proven international product that is widely received everywhere. Here are the estimated financial details for starting a Taco Bell franchise:

  • Franchise Fee: USD $25,000 – $45,000

  • Estimated Initial Investment: USD $576,000 – $3,370,100

  • Net Worth Requirement: Minimum USD $1.5 million

  • Liquid Assets Required: At least USD $750,000

  • Royalty Fee: 5.5% of gross sales

  • Marketing Contribution: Around 4.25% of gross sales

With the high investment cost, Taco Bell franchise business packages also include real estate and site selection support, construction guidance, design assistance, brand marketing, and operations training from the official Taco Bell team. All of this makes the Taco Bell franchise business an appealing investment for entrepreneurs who are new to the business and are looking at an opportunity that could instantly get them the business momentum.

Owning a Taco Bell franchise business provides several strong advantages that make it one of the top fast food business opportunities worldwide. These advantages will help to bring profit faster and bigger for franchisees. The advantages are :

  1. Global Brand Recognition
    Taco Bell is not just another fast food chain, but it is an internationally recognized brand with a massive history to consumers and even loyal customers of the brand. By joining the Taco Bell franchise, franchisees instantly gain credibility and a built-in customer base from day one without having to create a new marketing strategy to help the outlet to be seen as people will already know what they are getting going to the place.

  2. Menu Innovation and Adaptability
    One of Taco Bell’s strongest advantages is its ability to continuously innovate. Limited-time offers, unique flavors, and creative campaigns keep customers excited. At the same time, the brand adapts to local tastes, for example in Indonesia the Taco Bell adjusted it with the marking by giving a rice option in “Nasi Kebuli” with fried chicken alongside it. This makes the Taco Bell franchise business relevant in diverse markets.

  3. Flexible Store Formats
    Franchisees can choose the store format from a freestanding drive-thru restaurant, to a store in shopping centers, or  even smaller express outlets in airports. Taco Bell is able to provide multiple formats. This flexibility makes it easier for franchisees to adapt to different real estate opportunities and budget ranges that can kickstart their business and find the sweet spot for their preferred way to business.

  4. Comprehensive Training and Support
    Every Taco Bell franchisee will receive in-depth training in operations, customer service, and management. Alongside the training, Taco Bell will also provide continuous support in marketing, technology, and supply chain logistics, ensuring franchisees can focus on growing their business with confidence and not be afraid of losing direction when running the business.

  5. Backed by Yum! Brands
    As part of Yum! Brands Inc., which also owns KFC and Pizza Hut, Taco Bell also benefits from massive global infrastructure, shared resources, and proven systems where franchisees can also get access to decades of experience in scaling restaurant businesses worldwide immediately.

  6. Proven Profitability and Market Growth
    With more than 8,000 restaurants in 30+ countries, the Taco Bell franchise business has shown its ability to succeed across different economies and market trends. Taco Bell continues to expand internationally, giving investors the chance to get into a growth-oriented and profitable fast food market.

  7. Full Marketing Support
    Taco Bell franchise business will provide full marketing support for each franchisee from local advertising to digital advertising such as ad templates, SEO, and email marketing will be fully helped by the franchisor so franchisees do not need to think the marketing from scratch as some will be provided.


Taco Bell can be the ultimate fast food franchise for franchisees to pick if they are interested in operating a different kind of food from the mainstream fast food franchises available. With its take on Mexican cuisine to the support that are given from the franchisor, Taco Bell can be the perfect opportunity in the Mexican-inspired cuisine franchise to give profit faster and safer for entrepreneurs. If you are interested in opening your own Taco Bell, check this out for more information about Taco Bell franchise business.

title: Tips Presentasi Franchise yang Baik untuk Menarik Hati Calon Franchisee #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - Memikat hati orang bukanlah suatu hal yang mudah. Perlu beberapa langkah dan perkataan yang tepat untuk memenangkan hati orang tersebut untuk mau bekerja sama dengan kita. Ini sama halnya dengan ketika para franchisor sedang melakukan presentasi franchisenya. Presentasi franchise merupakan momen yang krusial juga untuk para franchisor bisa memperluas bisnisnya dengan mendapatkan franchisee. 

Presentasi franchise yang baik bukan cuma soal melihatkan angka saja, tapi juga bagaimana calon franchisee bisa merasa yakin kalau brand para franchisor memang layak buat dipilih. Banyak franchisor yang sebenarnya punya peluang besar, tapi gagal meyakinkan karena presentasi terasa kaku dan monoton. Nah, agar hal tersebut tidak terjadi di para franchisor, yuk simak beberapa tips presentasi franchise yang bisa bikin franchisee langsung jatuh hati dan gabung bersama!

Sebelum mulai presentasi, penting buat para franchisee untuk tahu siapa yang bakal akan dihadapi. Apakah calon franchisee mereka adalah seorang investor berpengalaman, pengusaha pemula, atau komunitas anak muda yang lagi cari peluang bisnis? Dengan mengenali audiens, penyampaian materi bisa lebih tepat sasaran dalam menjawab kebutuhan dan bisa lebih relate dengan para calon franchisee.

Salah satu cara presentasi franchise yang baik adalah dengan menggunakan storytelling. Ceritakan bagaimana brand franchisor dapat lahir, tantangan yang dilalui, hingga akhirnya bisa berkembang jadi franchise. Cerita yang kuat akan membuat audiens lebih mudah terhubung dan percaya sama brand franchisor.

Data tetap menjadi elemen penting dalam presentasi bisnis franchise. Informasi omzet, pertumbuhan outlet, serta proyeksi keuntungan secara singkat dan visual masih tetap menjadi salah satu poin terpenting untuk memenangkan hati para franchisee. Grafik atau infografis sederhana jauh lebih efektif daripada tabel angka yang bisa membuat calon franchisee bingung tentang data yang jelas dan juga akan membuat para calon franchisee lebih ingat dengan data yang disampaikan.

Calon franchisee pasti lebih ingin tahu apa yang bikin brand para franchisor ini berbeda dari ratusan pilihan franchise yang lain. Apakah punya menu atau layanan andalan yang khas, konsep bisnis unik, atau sistem operasional yang sudah terbukti gampang dijalankan? Tekankan keunikan itu supaya calon franchisee merasa brand dari franchisor punya identitas yang kuat dan bisa menarik pelanggan yang lebih banyak dengan keunikannya.

Materi yang bagus harus didukung penyampaian yang enak. Penyampaian dengan intonasi yang datar serta bahasa tubuh yang terlihat lemas akan sangat menilai bagaimana kinerja seorang franchisor, terutama dalam hal memimpin sebuah sistem bisnis. Cara agar penyampaian bisa tereksekusi dengan baik adalah dengan melatih cara bicara, intonasi, hingga bahasa tubuh agar presentasi bisa lebih hidup dan dinikmati oleh para calon franchisee. Kalau perlu untuk lebih yakin lagi dalam presentasi, franchisor bisa coba rekam diri sendiri untuk evaluasi sebelum tampil di depan calon franchisee.

Selain pembuka, penutup juga bermain sebagai hal yang penting dalam presentasi untuk meninggalkan impresi yang hangat kepada para calon franchisee. Jangan biarkan presentasi berhenti begitu saja. title: UPS Store Franchise Business, Shipping Profits for Franchisees in the U.S #StartFranchise

content:
StartFranchise.id - Online shopping has taken the whole world, especially in the U.S. As a result of online shopping, mailing and shipping also become a main sector in the U.S. Not only from online shopping, mailing and shipping is also used to send important documents, personal products and also marketing materials to everyone. A trusted mailing and shipping comes up every time mailing and shipping is needed in the U.S, and the trusted brand is The UPS Store.

Known as the largest retail shipping and mailing service center in the U.S, UPS Store is proven as a successful business model and also a perfect opportunity for those who are interested in the shipping and mailing business as UPS store opened its business as a franchise, perfect for those who want to join directly into the business area without having to build up from zero. UPS Store franchise business has opened thousands of outlets spread across the country to help faster and safer shipping to show that UPS Store franchise business is a profitable business model for franchisees.

UPS Store was founded in 1980 but under a different name, Mail Boxes Etc., the brand then rebranded in 2003 to become UPS Store, aligning itself directly with UPS, the global brand leading in logistics. Since then, it has grown into the go-to franchise for mailing, shipping, and small business solutions across the United States.

The UPS Store franchise business allows entrepreneurs to tap not just into one market, but multiple business sectors that could ensure profit for franchisees. From individual customers who need day-to-day shipping to small businesses requiring printing, marketing, and mailbox services, franchisees are given a wide base of potential customers from the different markets that are also supported by UPS’s global reputation.

Customers can get a wide range of services when going to the UPS Store. They are able to do more than just the typical shipping. This wide range can also benefit franchisees as it would help them reach a wider market and impact more people. As a nationwide franchise, UPS Store has core services that are available in every place. Those services are :

  • Shipping and Packaging: Domestic and international shipping solutions with reliable packaging options.

  • Mailbox Services: Personal and business mailbox rentals with secure package acceptance.

  • Printing and Document Services: Professional-quality printing for marketing materials, business cards, and posters.

  • Notary and Office Services: Faxing, scanning, shredding, and notary services for everyday customer needs.

  • E-commerce and Business Support: Helping small businesses handle shipping logistics, print marketing collateral, and manage virtual mailboxes.

This multi-service approach not only keeps customer demand steady but also opens up  more revenue streams for franchise owners as the market is more diverse rather than just focusing on one market only.

UPS store opened its door for aspiring entrepreneurs in their industry from the UPS Store franchise business. Future franchisees need to prepare the investment before jumping straight to profit land given by UPS Store franchise business. The investment breakdown for UPS Store franchise business is :

  • Initial Franchise Fee: Around USD $29,950.

  • Estimated Initial Investment: USD $247,306 – $476,993, depending on location and store format.

  • Ongoing Fees: Approximately 5% royalty fee on gross sales, plus national marketing contributions.

  • Financial Requirements: Net worth of around USD $150,000 and liquid assets of USD $60,000.

Compared to other nationwide franchise brands, UPS Store franchise business is a lot more affordable for the entry while still giving a lot of benefits of a nationwide franchise with the credibility of a company that thrives in global logistics.

As a nationwide franchise, UPS Store franchise business also gives benefits for the franchisees who join to drastically improve their starting point and also their everyday operation. Those benefits are :

  • Trusted Global Brand: With the UPS name, customers can instantly trust the service from day one, helping the franchisee get customers.

  • Proven Model: Decades of operational experience in retail shipping and business services and still thriving shows the business model as a proven one and able to provide income to the franchisees.

  • Diverse Revenue Opportunities: From shipping to printing to mailbox rentals, franchisees earn income from multiple services by just joining one franchise.

  • Training and Support: Franchisees receive comprehensive training, marketing support, and ongoing operational assistance, so they will not be lost when starting up and managing their own place.

  • High Market Demand: With e-commerce and small business growing more and more in the market, The UPS Store services are more relevant than ever.

UPS Store franchise business provides the upcoming entrepreneurs who are interested in the shipping and delivery business along with many other business sectors a chance to join and instantly start without having to build from ground zero. Joining the UPS Store franchise business will also give benefits to franchisees in their everyday operation.

For franchisees who are interested in the UPS Store franchise business, check this out. For those who are seeking international franchise opportunities or a business opportunity in Indonesia, check this out for more information.

title: What is a Franchise? Exploring the Business Model and The Benefits of Franchise #StartFranchise
creator: startfranchise.id@gmail.com
content:
StartFranchise.id - In today’s fast-moving and highly competitive business landscape, the franchise model has emerged as one of the most effective and scalable ways for entrepreneurs to start a business while minimizing risk of not getting the investment back. Whether you're an aspiring business owner looking for a turnkey opportunity or an established brand aiming to expand rapidly, franchising offers a structured pathway to growth. From global food chains like McDonald’s and Subway to local service-based concepts in education, wellness, and retail, the franchise ecosystem empowers both franchisors and franchisees to build successful ventures using a tested and replicable system. 

By upscaling the brand value, operational support, and proven business models, franchising reduces the guesswork, thus making it a go-to option for entrepreneurs who want to run a business with a higher chance of long-term success.

A franchise is a business agreement where a company (the franchisor) licenses its brand, operational systems, and business rights to another party (the franchisee). In exchange, the franchisee typically pays an initial franchise fee and recurring royalties in amount and duration discussed with the franchisor.

According to the International Franchise Association (IFA), franchising is “a method for expanding a business and distributing goods and services through a licensing relationship.” This setup helps franchisees tap into a business model that has already been tested and optimized by the franchisor, along with the brand value and customers that are included when licensing the brand.

You’ll encounter a variety of franchise models, such as product distribution franchises, manufacturing, job, conversion, master, and area development franchises. But the most common and accessible model is the Business Format Franchise.

Business Format Franchise in a nutshell is franchisor provides the franchisee with a complete business system, which include brand identity, SOPs, training, marketing, and continuous support from franchisor. It’s a lower-risk way to launch a business using a proven formula.

Real-world examples:

  • McDonald’s – One of the world’s most recognized fast-food franchises, with strict operational systems.

  • Anytime Fitness – A global gym franchise that offers full onboarding, marketing tools, and business coaching for its franchisees.

  • Budget Blinds – A home services franchise with complete setup and scalable systems.

For entrepreneurs aiming for brand support, consistency, and long-term growth, the Business Format Franchise is often the best choice. It combines autonomy with the safety net of franchisor guidance, making it ideal for first-time franchisees.

Franchising has a lot of benefits for franchisees as it helps them in giving a headstart for their business of choice as the franchisor would prepare a few things for franchisees. According to Forbes, one of the benefits of being a franchisee is buying a ready-made recipe for business success as franchisors who opened their business for franchise already cracked the code for success with their business and franchisees just need to follow them. Not only that, here are also some of the benefits from franchise for the franchisees : 

1. Established Brand Recognition

A franchise gives all of the franchisees instant access to a recognizable brand, saving entrepreneurs who joined the franchise years of building credibility and customer trust.

2. Training and Support

Most franchisors offer extensive training and continued support. For example, McDonald's provides 12–18 months of hands-on training for new franchisees before they can open their first location.

3. Easier Access to Financing

Lenders are often more willing to provide capital to franchisees because franchises have a lower failure rate than startups. Some franchisors also offer financing options or preferred lending partners.

4. Group Purchasing Power

Franchisees benefit from the collective power of the franchise network, allowing for cost savings on inventory, equipment, and marketing through bulk buying agreements arranged by the franchisor.

Also Read : Apa itu Franchise? Pengertian, Jenis, dan Keuntungannya #StartFranchise

The franchise model not only gives benefits to the franchisees who are exploring the franchise, but also for the franchisors to have the opportunity to scale rapidly and efficiently:

  • Franchisors can grow their brand with less capital by letting franchisees invest in new locations.

  • Expansion is quicker due to local franchisee ownership and management.

  • Revenue streams from franchise fees and ongoing royalties create long-term profitability.

  • Widespread franchise locations increase brand visibility and market dominance.

Before becoming a franchisee, there are some things need to be considered, whether in what type of franchise and in the more detailed way, as in the financing.

Franchisees probably shouldn’t invest in a presumably top-performing franchise just because it has worked out well for other franchisees. The rule of thumb is to go for the franchise that aligns with the franchisee’s interests, strengths, skills and expectations.

If the franchise that the franchisee pick has matched with their interest,franchisees need to make sure about a few things before investing in the franchise and signing the deal : 

  • Total initial investment and franchise fee

  • Ongoing royalties and advertising fees

  • Support and training offered by the franchisor

  • Territory rights and restrictions

  • Terms of the franchise agreement and exit strategy

Always read the Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD) carefully and consult with your closest people first or a professional business consultant before signing any deal given by a franchisor to make sure the deal given to you is in alignment with your goal in opening the business.

In short, a franchise is a business model where a franchisor grants the rights to use its brand, system, and proven methods to a franchisee, allowing both parties to grow together. This model offers significant benefits starting from lower startup risks and established brand recognition to continuous support and a faster route to profitability that could be felt by both franchisees and franchisors

Whether the franchisees choose a product distribution franchise, a management franchise, or the ever-popular business format franchise, the opportunities are vast and adaptable to various industries. By tapping into a tested concept, franchisees are not just starting a business, but they are stepping into a partnership designed for mutual success which has been tailored by franchisors.

title: FAQ
content:
FAQs

  • Semuanya berawal dari sebuah kebutuhan. Mungkin Anda ingin memulai bisnis sendiri. Mungkin Anda sedang mencari peluang usaha yang sudah terbukti. Atau mungkin Anda mewakili brand dan ingin memperluas jaringan mitra bisnis. Apa pun tujuannya, Start Franchise hadir sebagai platform yang menghubungkan brand dengan calon franchisee, baik secara online maupun lewat pameran langsung seperti SFIE. Cara Anda memperkenalkan brand atau menemukan peluang yang tepat bisa mengubah arah perjalanan bisnis Anda.

  • Semuanya berawal dari eksposur. Mungkin Anda ingin brand Anda dikenal lebih luas. Mungkin Anda ingin menjaring calon mitra berkualitas. Atau mungkin Anda ingin menunjukkan keseriusan brand Anda kepada publik. Di SFIE, kami tidak hanya menyediakan ruang pamer, tapi juga spotlight—untuk brand Anda tampil, dilihat, dan dipilih. SFIE bukan sekadar event, ini adalah launchpad untuk ekspansi bisnis Anda.

  • Semuanya berawal dari visibilitas. Di era digital, calon mitra Anda mencari informasi lewat Google dan media sosial. Dengan lebih dari 30.000 followers aktif, halaman yang rutin muncul di pencarian teratas, serta konten yang dikurasi khusus untuk pencari bisnis, StartFranchise.id menjadi tempat yang tepat untuk tampil. Upload brand Anda bisa dimulai dari GRATIS—dan bisa berkembang menjadi sesuatu yang jauh lebih besar

  • Semuanya berawal dari satu langkah sederhana. Cukup isi formulir di website kami, atau klik tautan pendaftaran yang kami kirim. Tim kami akan membantu memastikan brand Anda tampil optimal—baik di website maupun di event kami. Kami percaya, setiap brand punya cerita. Dan tugas kami adalah membantu Anda membagikannya ke dunia yang lebih luas.

  • Semuanya berawal dari potensi. Anda tidak perlu menjadi brand nasional dulu untuk layak tampil. Banyak brand yang kami bantu mulai dari skala kecil dan lokal, lalu berkembang berkat eksposur yang tepat. Di Start Franchise, kami percaya bahwa brand kecil dengan sistem solid dan niat besar punya tempat untuk tumbuh dan kami di sini untuk membuka jalannya.

  • Semuanya berawal dari perhatian yang tepat. Audiens kami bukan hanya orang yang “suka lihat-lihat”, tapi mereka yang memang sedang mencari peluang untuk join bisnis. Mereka adalah calon franchisee, investor individu, pemilik lahan, bahkan komunitas entrepreneur yang aktif. Brand Anda akan tampil di depan mata orang yang tepat, di waktu yang tepat.

  • Semuanya berawal dari pendekatan yang berbeda. Kami bukan sekadar direktori. Kami adalah media, komunitas, sekaligus ekosistem untuk brand berkembang. Dengan kombinasi website, event offline (SFIE), media sosial aktif, dan pendekatan personal, kami bantu brand Anda tidak hanya terlihat, tapi juga terkoneksi. Karena menurut kami, branding yang kuat itu bukan sekadar visual tapi interaksi yang nyata.

  • Sebaiknya, seorang pembeli waralaba berhubungan langsung dengan pemilik waralaba saat membeli waralaba, karena pertemuan pra-kontrak mereka akan menjadi dasar untuk hubungan jangka panjang yang mungkin terjadi. Pemilik waralaba berada di posisi terbaik untuk menjelaskan proposal kepada pembeli waralaba. Pemilik waralaba akan memahami motivasi dan kekhawatiran calon pembeli waralaba yang akan memulai bisnisnya sendiri.

    Ada bahaya jika pemilik waralaba menggunakan broker, yaitu broker mungkin tidak memahami bisnis waralaba dan pemilik waralaba mungkin tidak cukup mengenal broker untuk mengandalkan penilaiannya mengenai kesesuaian pembeli waralaba. Dari sudut pandang pembeli waralaba, jika penyaringan awal dilakukan oleh broker, ia tidak akan mendapatkan pengalaman bertemu dengan pemilik waralaba, yang memungkinkannya menilai apakah ia bisa bekerja sama dengan mereka berdasarkan pendekatan pribadi dan gaya manajemen mereka. Sangatlah penting bagi calon pembeli waralaba untuk berbicara langsung dengan pemilik waralaba dan pembeli waralaba lainnya dalam jaringan sebelum ia membuat keputusan apakah akan membeli waralaba atau tidak.

  • Sangatlah penting bagi pemilik waralaba untuk melakukan uji coba percontohan pada sistem waralabanya. Tujuannya agar pembeli waralaba yakin bahwa mereka berinvestasi pada konsep bisnis yang berhasil dan telah diuji secara menyeluruh. Sangat penting bagi pemilik waralaba untuk mengoperasikan setidaknya satu unit percontohan, dan dalam banyak kasus, beberapa unit percontohan harus didirikan.

    Uji coba ini sebaiknya dilakukan di lokasi yang mirip atau mewakili lokasi tempat pembeli waralaba diperkirakan akan beroperasi. Mungkin juga diperlukan untuk menjalankan unit percontohan selama periode yang panjang, umumnya lebih dari 12 bulan, terutama jika faktor musiman harus diperhitungkan.

    Unit percontohan akan:

    • Memberikan bukti bahwa barang dan/atau jasa yang diberikan kepada konsumen memiliki daya jual di pasar.

    • Mengidentifikasi lokasi, sifat, dan luas tempat untuk operasional waralaba, atau jika bisnisnya bergerak (mobile), menemukan metode optimal untuk melengkapi dan melengkapi kendaraan.

    • Menentukan cara optimal penggunaan peralatan untuk waralaba.

    • Mengembangkan manual operasional dengan rincian lengkap sistem yang akan digunakan untuk melatih pembeli waralaba dan sebagai catatan.

    • Membangun sistem bisnis, operasional, dan pemasaran.

    Sebagai calon pembeli waralaba dari sistem waralaba yang baru, Anda perlu meyakinkan diri bahwa uji coba percontohan yang dilakukan oleh pemilik waralaba sudah memadai.

  • Isi rencana bisnis akan bervariasi tergantung siapa yang akan membacanya:

    • Untuk Bank (Fokus pada Keuangan Pribadi): Bank ingin melihat apakah Anda dapat mengelola keuangan pribadi Anda, jadi rencana harus mencakup:

      • Latar belakang kerja dan pengalaman bisnis.

      • Pendapatan lain, tanggungan, dan aset/liabilitas pribadi.

      • Proyeksi omzet, laba rugi, dan arus kas.

      • Skenario terbaik dan terburuk yang realistis.

    • Untuk Pemilik Waralaba (Fokus pada Operasional Harian): Pemilik waralaba ingin melihat bagaimana Anda akan menjalankan bisnis, jadi rencana harus mencakup:

      • Analisis peluang di area Anda.

      • Rencana Anda untuk menarik pelanggan dan mengembangkan bisnis.

      • Sistem operasional dan staf.

      • Proyeksi keuangan dan anggaran, termasuk semua biaya operasional, pemasaran, dan pembayaran pinjaman.

  • Rencana bisnis bukan dokumen yang dibuat sekali lalu dilupakan. Rencana ini harus menjadi dokumen hidup yang Anda tinjau dan perbarui secara berkala. Para ahli menyarankan untuk bekerja sama dengan konsultan independen yang berpengalaman dalam perencanaan bisnis waralaba untuk memastikan semua biaya telah diperhitungkan secara akurat.

  • Saat berbicara dengan pembeli waralaba, fokuslah pada hal-hal selain keuangan. Berikut beberapa pertanyaan kunci:

    • Apakah pemilik waralaba menepati janji yang dibuat saat proses rekrutmen?

    • Seberapa akurat model keuangan yang diberikan oleh pemilik waralaba?

    • Bagaimana efektivitas proses pelatihan dan masa orientasi?

    • Bagaimana perkembangan jaringan waralaba di masa depan menurut pandangan mereka?

    • Bagaimana dukungan yang diberikan pemilik waralaba?

    • Bagaimana semangat dan interaksi antar-pembeli waralaba dalam jaringan?

  • Konsep waralaba turnkey adalah model bisnis di mana sebagian besar proses pendirian telah diurus oleh pemilik waralaba, sehingga pembeli waralaba hanya perlu "memutar kunci" dan langsung beroperasi. Model ini biasanya mencakup pelatihan awal, pasokan stok, perangkat lunak, dukungan pemasaran, dan terkadang, bahkan urusan properti. Meskipun banyak waralaba tidak sepenuhnya turnkey karena pembeli waralaba seringkali harus mencari dan menyiapkan tempat sendiri, model ini sangat umum ditemukan pada waralaba berbasis kendaraan seperti waralaba van atau gerai makanan cepat saji.

    Keuntungan Waralaba Turnkey

    Waralaba turnkey menawarkan beberapa manfaat signifikan bagi calon pengusaha:

    1. Bisnis Siap Berjalan: Model ini menghilangkan banyak pekerjaan awal yang rumit seperti mencari lokasi, perizinan, dan desain gerai, memungkinkan pembeli waralaba fokus pada pelatihan dan operasional bisnis.

    2. Peluncuran Lebih Cepat: Karena semua persiapan diurus oleh pemilik waralaba, bisnis bisa diluncurkan lebih cepat, memberikan keuntungan di pasar yang kompetitif.

    3. Mengurangi Stres dan Risiko: Pemilik waralaba biasanya memiliki pengalaman dan jaringan kontraktor tepercaya. Hal ini membantu menghindari penundaan atau biaya tak terduga yang sering terjadi dalam renovasi properti.

    4. Akses ke Keahlian dan Jaringan: Pembeli waralaba mendapat manfaat dari hubungan yang sudah ada antara pemilik waralaba dengan pemasok, agen properti, dan kontraktor.
